verdict.rationale: Base44 apps get a live URL with auto-issued SSL and can add a custom domain (base44-docs-8, base44-docs-26, base44-docs-42), and a community user confirms building and deploying an app quickly ('two prompts and deploy', base44-comm-6), supporting one-step publishing. However, there's no explicit first-party doc describing the exact 'Publish' button/flow itself (only domain-setup and post-publish steps are documented). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the publish action/button and its default URL format, plus independent verification of the one-step claim beyond a single anecdote.
